other_conditions: Candidate must have a postgraduate (PG) degree from any university in Kerala.
Candidate must register for a Ph.D. programme in a university or research centre in Kerala.
Minimum PG marks: 70% (or equivalent CGPA) for General and OBC candidates; 65% for SC, ST and differently‑abled candidates.
Three consecutive chances to apply after qualifying the PG degree.
Must submit an acceptance letter within the time mentioned in the offer letter.
After university registration, a copy of the registration order, supervising teacher’s letter confirming no other fellowship, and a joining report must be sent to the Council.
If the fellowship is terminated, the Council must be informed through the Head of the Institution and the supervising teacher.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹31,000 for the first two years and ₹35,000 in the third year, plus an annual contingency grant of ₹20,000 and hostel accommodation (with HRA up to 10%).
documents_required: Letter from supervising teacher confirming the fellow is not receiving any other fellowship
Joining report indicating effective date of joining at the research centre
